historical_record.description: An existing mixed-use building with a residential unit at the second floor stood on the site.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use, with conditions including removal of the 4th floor, to demolish an existing mixed-use building with a residential unit at the second floor and build a mixed-use building with residential units and one commercial unit without the four required residential parking spaces.
